steps.en: Officer can open a summary of the offence just entered
steps.id: Officer bisa membuka ringkasan offence yang baru diisi

steps.en: Officer confirms creation, but seeing the summary is not required first
steps.id: Officer konfirmasi pembuatan, tetapi melihat ringkasan tidak diwajibkan dulu
steps.why_en: The confirmation box shows no summary, and nothing makes the officer open the summary before confirming.
steps.why_id: Kotak konfirmasi tidak memuat ringkasan, dan tidak ada yang mewajibkan officer membuka ringkasan sebelum konfirmasi.

steps.en: After uploading, officer sees a review page with all rows
steps.id: Setelah upload, officer melihat halaman review berisi semua baris

steps.en: The review lists key columns; full details open one row at a time
steps.id: Review menampilkan kolom utama; detail lengkap dibuka satu baris satu kali
steps.why_en: The review list shows only four columns; the full details of each row need a separate page.
steps.why_id: Daftar review hanya menampilkan empat kolom; detail lengkap tiap baris perlu halaman terpisah.

steps.en: Officer confirms creating all uploaded notices from the review page
steps.id: Officer konfirmasi pembuatan semua notice upload dari halaman review
